items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I had taken old Teagarden out there one night

ctx.x: Yes, they were great gamblers. They used to gamble with the Chinese people out there. See, and boy when you come into the place they had a big chef that was frying chicken and hot biscuits. Boy and I had taken old Teagarden out there one night and that cat ate three orders of fried chicken and biscuits. Hot dog. And you could see, that's the first thing you saw when you walked in the place. Was this big chef and so clean and nice you know. And that fried chicken, you could smell that fried chicken. And boy, that…

And that's why I say that Zutty had such a good heart. He never thought about black or white. Dave came to California from the Navy. Checked into a hotel, oh, like the Hilton, a good hotel. And he looked in the 'phone book or in the musician book and found our telephone number. And he called Zutty and he told him he was at this hotel. And so he asked Zutty if we were rooming or if we had a house, an apartment. And Zutty told him, he said I have a house. He said, I'll be right over, I'm checking out. And he came…
